acceptance_evidence: CCA verdict and MergeGate evidence are recorded before completion.
completion_conditions: Task registration injects the task's own id-scoped mirror locks, derived deterministically from the task id and goal id.
The injected set is exactly what the loop's evidence sync can write, and nothing broader — no directory glob over a shared namespace.
Frozen-plan matching accepts a registered task whose locks are the plan's locks plus exactly the derivable injected set, and rejects any other difference.
Every task in the four frozen plans passes files_outside_locks against the files the loop syncs.
Two registered tasks' injected mirror locks never conflict with each other.

decisions: The A-LOCKS narrowing was correct about product paths and wrong to drop mirror coverage with no replacement: the loop unconditionally syncs .shiki/tasks/<task>.json, .shiki/worktrees/<task>.json, .shiki/goals/<goal>.json, .shiki/locks/<task>.json and every ledger in ledger_evidence, and files_outside_locks blocks each of them.

Plan-time locks cannot name these files because the ids do not exist until registration. Injection at registration is therefore the only narrow option; a directory glob would restore the collision A-LOCKS removed.
Injected locks are id-scoped, so two tasks' injected sets are disjoint by construction and never conflict.
Frozen-plan matching must not simply ignore locks — that would let a registration widen them. It accepts plan locks plus exactly the recomputed injected set, and rejects anything else.

This goal is deliberately single-task and declares path:.shiki/** for itself. That is the circularity break: it is the one task in flight, so the blanket lock contends with nothing, and it is the task that removes the need for it.
grill_with_docs.source: Framework review 2026-07-28 (Workflow w0a858ss3), Wave 0 item 1. Verified against HEAD: 26 of 27 frozen tasks block on their own synced mirror files after the A-LOCKS narrowing, and loop_guaranteed_locks — the compensating control cited in validate_shiki's advisory docstring — does not exist.

non_goals: Exempting .shiki paths from files_outside_locks — that is ADR 0016's step B and requires the mirror-identity rule (remediation R-02) to be in force first.
Changing what the loop syncs, or the lock conflict algorithm.
Changing product-path locks declared at plan time.
outcome: A registered task's declared locks always cover the mirror files the goal loop will sync onto its branch, without any task declaring a blanket path:.shiki/** lock. Narrow product-path locks (ADR 0016 / A-LOCKS) and mirror lock coverage stop being mutually exclusive, so tasks can run concurrently and still pass files_outside_locks on their own evidence.
title: Guarantee mirror lock coverage at registration
